facts.value:
Mary MILLETT was born  1735 in Beverly, Essex county, MA to Nathaniel MILLETT and Elizabeth MORGAN. She had a brother Ebenezer who served in the British militia with his best friend, a Scotsman named Alexander MILLS b ca 1738. Alex saved Eb' s life.  They were in battles in Nova Scotia and after Ev healed they went to  where Ebenezer married. They traveled back to Beverly MA where Eb' introduced Alex to his sister Mary born 1735 in Beverly MA. Alexander and Mary married on 22 March 1759 in Beverly. 

Many people get Alexander and mixed up with another couple with the same names. They have intertwined the children. Alex and Mary who married in 1759 NEVER lived in Maryland EVER. They lived in MA and VT and possibly a short stint in NH. They did not have triplets born in 1770.
